import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event}

{title_of_event}

Date: {scheduled_date}

{event_details}
{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Args: title_of_event (str): The name or title of the event. event_details (str): A comprehensive description of the event. May contain multiple lines and formatting. scheduled_date (str): The scheduled date for the event. extra_info (str): Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns: str: A string containing sanitized HTML for safely displaying the event invitation. """ # Escape all user-provided input to neutralize potential XSS content escaped_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) escaped_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") escaped_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) escaped_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format the invitation using the template return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=escaped_title, event_details=escaped_details, scheduled_date=escaped_date, extra_info=escaped_extra )
